# Bounded artifact rule map

Use this as temporary evidence for one approved batch. It is not policy, approval, or a permanent duplicate specification. Keep quotations only as long as needed to make the comparison reviewable.

For each removed sentence, identify every complete retained equivalent in the candidate. “Obsolete,” implied, or covered elsewhere without adequate local exposure is not a preservation disposition.
